eyebrow: Page cache — Neo4j's buffer pool equivalent
caption: Undersizing the page cache is the most common cause of unexplained slowness.
Look for NodeIndexSeek, not NodeByLabelScan, on an indexed property.

eyebrow: The real anti-pattern: no label, no index
code:
-- scans every node in the graph
MATCH (n {email: 'jane@example.com'}) RETURN n

-- fixed: label + index = a seek
CREATE INDEX customer_email
  FOR (c:Customer) ON (c.email);
caption: Same reasoning as a missing index causing a SQL Server table scan.
